name: Example Evidence-Readiness Agent
description: Structured evidence triage for strategic-risk source packs. Returns readiness routing, evidence gaps, and mandatory human review before any commercial action. Not legal, compliance, financial, or investment advice; not an autonomous decision system.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Bearer access key for the production message/send route. While unset the route is an open free demo and no key is required.

skills.name: Evidence triage
skills.description: Converts a source pack into readiness routing with evidence gaps and human-review escalation.

skills.name: Source planning
skills.description: Returns required source categories and watch-next indicators for a risk question.
